claims.rationale: E_04 confirms ransomware constituted 17% of incidents remediated in 2022, held the top action-on-objective spot since at least 2020, extortion was the most common attack impact at 27%, and phishing was the top initial access vector at 41%. The statement that these observations (share and prevalence) do not constitute direct NoI incident-count/frequency trajectory evidence is a valid logical boundary inference.

E_03 confirms the global median dwell time in 2022 was 16 days (down from 21 days in M-Trends 2022) and that ransomware intrusions had a median dwell time of 9 days in 2022 compared to 5 days in M-Trends 2022, while crediting ransomware as a driving factor in the reduction. The statement that dwell-time is a detection-speed metric and not direct NoI trajectory evidence is a valid logical boundary inference.
